title.narrative: EU Support to Strengthening IBM in Ukraine - Resilience (EU4IBM-Resilience

description.narrative:
The purpose of the project is to ensure, in the long term, safe international mobility of people, including by countering human trafficking, irregular migration and other forms of security threats, facilitation of trade through adapted trade routes, and increased level of security at the Ukrainian borders protecting both UA and EU from conventional and hybrid threats and knock-on effects increased by the war situation.

The specific objectives (outcomes) of the action are presented in the table below, clustered by the outputs (results) and grouped into corresponding components:

-       Component 1. Border Management Resilience;

-       Component 2. Trade Facilitation;

-       Component 3. Sector Management Support;

-       Component 4. Secured operation of legislature during wartime

comment.narrative: SBGS a Concept Note on Procurement of Border Surveillance and Control Equipment with 7 priorities tentative timelines and costs was prepared jointly with the donor and the beneficiary and was endorsed in January 2023. Development of TSs for all 7 positions and market research were launched in December 2022.1.TS for Mobile devices for nondestructive inspection of objects were available from the previous project2.TS for portable radio stations were revised to propose a more advanced model endorsed in February 20233.TS for Mobile thermal imaging complexes was launched in November 2022 based on SBGS needs and technical requirements final TS endorsed in June 20234.TS for Local Independent Seismic Surveillance System were endorsed in August 2023 however procurement was on hold until the April 2024 top up TS were further reviewed to accommodate the existing SBGS LISSS architecture and finally endorsed in May 20245.TS for UAV were developed in August 2023 and endorsed in September 20236.TS for HBDCO2 detectors were developed in September 20237.Development of TS for Micro cameras was put on hold as soon as budget limitations became clearFurther due to budget constraints priorities were reviewed and split into 2 waves.1st priority wave1.20 mobile devices for nondestructive inspection of objects mini scanners March 20232.500 portable radio stations September 20233.5 Mobile thermal imaging complexes contracted with the delivery deadline of August 20242nd priority wave4.Local Independent Seismic Surveillance System up to 20 pcs depending on the offersavailable budget procurement notice to be published in June 2024Other priority items 57 could not be accommodated within the available budget therefore the final priority list contains only four points.
